name: MintPDF
description: Turns HTML or Markdown into a styled PDF, or renders a public web page to PDF, and returns a download link valid for one hour.

skills.name: Generate a PDF from HTML or Markdown
skills.description: Render HTML or Markdown into a styled PDF and return a download URL. Markdown is styled with a clean default stylesheet.
examples: Turn this summary into a one-page PDF with page numbers
Render this invoice markdown as an A4 PDF

skills.name: Render a web page to PDF
skills.description: Load a public http(s) page and render it to PDF, returning a download URL.
examples: Save this article as a PDF
Capture this page as an A4 document
